reviews.title: Crucial RAM works well for me!
reviews.comment: I have Crucial solid state drives that work much better than the old spinning disk drives. I'm happy with them and that brand, so I was pretty sure that these would be good enough quality, and a value for the money for the kind of uses I have for my desktop. They snapped right into place; the hardest part for me was seeing the slots where they went! I've had them in for a couple of days and everything works fine!
reviews.author: Scott Gilbert

reviews.title: Legit!
reviews.comment: The memory sticks are legit and work well, especially for my PC that is strict on SPD requiring true JEDEC‑2666 profile. Excellent!
reviews.author: Duke33

reviews.title: Works for HP 800 G2 MiniTower
reviews.comment: I put this 32GB kit (16GBx2 dual rank, 2666 MT/s) in the HP 800 G2 MiniTower and it works well.  The speeds are a little faster than the stock 16 GB of RAM it came with.  As for performance, Windows 10 and all of the overhead that is run with the system are now happy.  I also run VMs on this system and the extra memory is helpful with this level of multitasking.  I tested this initially with MemTest 86  and have no issues.
reviews.author: MS09

reviews.comment: Did not use. Not quite what I needed. However, I hear nothing but great things about Crucial. Highly recommend.

reviews.title: works well so far, and at less than half the cost of dell
reviews.comment: purchased a dell optiplex 3070 during the holiday deal cycle as I loved the form factor.  however, the black friday deal i got only came with 8 gigs of ram.  i like to have a lot of windows, programs, and browser tabs open all at once, so more ram was a huge need. i looked at many options, but this crucial kit seemed to be the one to try.  32gigs of ram was what i was looking for, compatible with the dell 3070, and at a price less than half of what it would've costed from dell.  so far so good
reviews.author: d808
